parameters.description: The name of the dataset.

parameters.description: Enable to use Alchemy. Note: The appropriate Alchemy version is selected for the specified model. For example, XL models will use Alchemy V2.
parameters.name: alchemy

parameters.description: Contrast Ratio to use with Alchemy. Must be a float between 0 and 1 inclusive.
parameters.name: contrast_ratio

parameters.description: Adjusts the contrast level of the generated image. Used in Phoenix and Flux models. Accepts values [1.0, 1.3, 1.8, 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4, 4.5]. For Phoenix, if alchemy is true, contrast needs to be 2.5 or higher.
parameters.name: contrast

parameters.description: Controlnets.
parameters.name: controlnets

initImageId.description: The ID of the init image

initImageType.description: Type indicating whether the init image is uploaded or generated.

preprocessorId.description: ID of the controlnet. A list of compatible IDs can be found in our guides.

strengthType.description: Strength type for the controlnet. Can only be used for Style, Character and Content Reference controlnets.

parameters.description: Elements.
parameters.name: elements

parameters.description: User elements.
parameters.name: user_elements

userLoraId.description: Unique identifier for user custom element.

parameters.description: Enable to use the Expanded Domain feature of Alchemy.
parameters.name: expanded_domain

parameters.description: Enable to use the Fantasy Avatar feature.
parameters.name: fantasy_avatar

parameters.description: How strongly the generation should reflect the prompt. 7 is recommended. Must be between 1 and 20.
parameters.name: guidance_scale

parameters.description: The input height of the images. Must be between 32 and 1536 and be a multiple of 8. Note: Input resolution is not always the same as output resolution due to upscaling from other features.
parameters.name: height

parameters.description: Enable to use the High Contrast feature of Prompt Magic. Note: Controls RAW mode. Set to false to enable RAW mode.
parameters.name: high_contrast

parameters.description: Enable to use the High Resolution feature of Prompt Magic.
parameters.name: high_resolution

parameters.description: Image prompts.
parameters.name: image_prompts

parameters.description: The ID of an existing image to use in image2image.

parameters.description: The ID of an Init Image to use in image2image.
parameters.name: init_image_id

parameters.description: How strongly the generated images should reflect the original image in image2image. Must be a float between 0.1 and 0.9.
parameters.name: init_strength

parameters.description: The model ID used for image generation. If not provided, uses sd_version to determine the version of Stable Diffusion to use. In-app, model IDs are under the Finetune Models menu. Click on the platform model or your custom model, then click View More. For platform models, you can also use the List Platform Models API.
parameters.name: model_id

parameters.description: The negative prompt used for the image generation
parameters.name: negative_prompt

parameters.description: The number of images to generate. Must be between 1 and 8. If either width or height is over 768, must be between 1 and 4.
parameters.name: num_images

parameters.description: The Step Count to use for the generation. Must be between 10 and 60. Default is 15.
parameters.name: num_inference_steps

parameters.description: Enable the photoReal feature. Requires enabling alchemy and unspecifying modelId (for photoRealVersion V1).
parameters.name: photo_real

parameters.description: The version of photoReal to use. Must be v1 or v2.
parameters.name: photo_real_version

parameters.description: Depth of field of photoReal. Must be 0.55 for low, 0.5 for medium, or 0.45 for high. Defaults to 0.55 if not specified.
parameters.name: photo_real_strength

parameters.description: The style to generate images with. When photoReal is enabled, refer to the Guide section for a full list. When alchemy is disabled, use LEONARDO or NONE. When alchemy is enabled, use ANIME, CREATIVE, DYNAMIC, ENVIRONMENT, GENERAL, ILLUSTRATION, PHOTOGRAPHY, RAYTRACED, RENDER_3D, SKETCH_BW, SKETCH_COLOR, or NONE.
parameters.name: preset_style

parameters.description: The prompt used to generate images
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.description: Enable to use Prompt Magic.
parameters.name: prompt_magic

parameters.description: Strength of prompt magic. Must be a float between 0.1 and 1.0
parameters.name: prompt_magic_strength

parameters.description: Prompt magic version v2 or v3, for use when promptMagic: true
parameters.name: prompt_magic_version

parameters.description: Whether the generated images should show in the community feed.
parameters.name: public

parameters.description: The scheduler to generate images with. Defaults to EULER_DISCRETE if not specified.
parameters.name: scheduler

parameters.description: The base version of stable diffusion to use if not using a custom model. v1_5 is 1.5, v2 is 2.1, if not specified it will default to v1_5. Also includes SDXL and SDXL Lightning models
parameters.name: sd_version

parameters.description: Apply a fixed seed to maintain consistency across generation sets. The maximum seed value is 2147483637 for Flux and 9999999998 for other models
parameters.name: seed

parameters.description: Whether the generated images should tile on all axis.
parameters.name: tiling

parameters.description: Which type of transparency this image should use
parameters.name: transparency

parameters.description: Enable to use Ultra mode. Note: can not be used with Alchemy.
parameters.name: ultra

parameters.description: Whether the generated images should be unzoomed (requires unzoomAmount and init_image_id to be set).
parameters.name: unzoom

parameters.description: How much the image should be unzoomed (requires an init_image_id and unzoom to be set to true).
parameters.name: unzoom_amount

parameters.description: How much the image should be upscaled. (Enterprise Only)
parameters.name: upscale_ratio

parameters.description: The input width of the images. Must be between 32 and 1536 and be a multiple of 8. Note: Input resolution is not always the same as output resolution due to upscaling from other features.
parameters.name: width
